shipped_rows.title_o: Cluster Headache is Associated With the Alcohol Dehydrogenase 4 ( ADH4 ) Gene
shipped_rows.authors_o: Rainero; Rubino; Gallone; Fenoglio; Negro; De Martino; Savi; Pinessi

blind_target.authors: Zarrilli F, Tomaiuolo R, Ceglia C, et al.
blind_target.title: Molecular analysis of cluster headache
blind_target.evidence_quote: The single nucleotide polymorphism (SNP) rs1126671 located in exon 7 of the ADH4 gene was associated with an increased risk for CH in two Italian studies, whereas rs1800759 located in the promoter region of ADH4 could only be associated with CH in the smaller case–control study. Thus, we performed a replication study on the ADH4 SNPs rs1126671 and rs1800759 in a large, Swedish case–control cohort in order to further investigate the possible contribution of ADH4 to CH.
blind_target.outcome_quote: The data did not support an association of the ADH4 SNPs rs1126671 and rs1800759 with CH.
blind_target.outcome_reasoning: The authors report no association for either variant, contrary to the associations reported by both cited Italian studies.

luna_triage.reason: The Swedish cohort is explicitly described as a replication of the ADH4 SNP associations. The text attributes the rs1126671 association to two Italian studies and the rs1800759 association to the smaller study, then lists Zarrilli et al. (2015) as one of those original reports. The shipped Rainero et al. (2010) row does not represent the distinct Zarrilli paper.
luna_triage.omission_quote: Objective To perform a replication study on the ADH4 SNPs rs1126671 and rs1800759 in a large homogeneous Swedish case–control cohort in order to further investigate the possible contribution of ADH4 to CH.
